==Usage==
To place the above box on a user's talk page, type the following: <code><nowiki>{{subst:FA notify|</nowiki>{{Var|article title}}<nowiki>|~~~~}}</nowiki></code>.

Remember to <code>subst</code> this template&mdash;it will not work properly if you don't.
